## Summary

Describe the research, claim, or operational change and its owning path.

## Validation

List focused validation, reproduced evidence, and any still-open research gate.

## Audit evidence

Run the repository quality gate and replace every checked line with concrete evidence; “done”, “checked”, and generic “n/a” entries are rejected.

<!-- audit-evidence:start -->
- [ ] 01: Name the canonical research or shared owner searched and how duplicate paths were excluded.
- [ ] 02: Name the normative source and trace the changed protocol, evidence, or publication path.
- [ ] 03: Describe required evidence and the explicit stop/failure behavior; identify any justified external fallback.
- [ ] 13: Record source/derived-document consistency and any regenerated publication artifact.
- [ ] 14: Record rendered desktop/mobile sizes, overflow, accessibility, and relevant state checks when the public site changes.
- [ ] 15: Cite claim sources and distinguish requirements, candidates, selected standards, and verified evidence.
- [ ] 16: Record visible-copy, terminology, locale, and placeholder checks in rendered context when public language changes.
- [ ] 27: Record legal, financial, privacy, and security review boundaries affected by the change.
- [ ] 30: List changed R1-R12 sections, decision/config/evidence owners inspected, conflicts, compound rules, and every still-open release gate.
<!-- audit-evidence:end -->
